description: The error reports the visual script (sdk/visual) sends to POST /api/v1/tracking/errors, each with exactly these keys. A report never carries feature_flag_key, user_id, the page's address or its text, so it never counts toward a feature flag. At most 5 reports per page view, all types together. `sent` says whether this version of the script sends the type.

types.index: The change's position in the variant's changes, from 0; null when the whole experiment was skipped.

reasons.invalid: The variant's changes, or this change, failed the script's check, or the browser could not read its selector. The whole experiment is skipped when the changes fail.
reasons.unsupported_operation: A change uses an operation this version of the script does not know. The whole experiment is skipped.
reasons.ambiguous: The selector matched more than one element.
reasons.not_allowed: The selector matched an element the script never changes this way (a script, style, frame or form element, or an element outside HTML).
reasons.reapply_limit: The page kept undoing the change, and the script stopped re-applying it.
reasons.replaced_after_bound: The page replaced the changed element after the script had stopped watching.

types.index: The change's position in the variant's changes, from 0.
types.means: The change's selector matched the page's root element (<html>) or the script's own banner, which the script never changes.
